scope: Original writing patterns, editorial angles, inferred viewer needs, and sampled visual-word relationships across the complete source timelines.

preserve.voiceAndSound: Approved Nhật Phong preset and sound approach

currentLifeExplainerPreferences.locationEvidence: Source-recorded place and URL; do not infer nationality/location from appearance or present archival prices as current offers.
currentLifeExplainerPreferences.motion: Use purposeful actual Three.js object animation plus the retained photo/gallery interface. Animate the narrated action or relationship; avoid long static holds and cluttered dashboard layouts.
currentLifeExplainerPreferences.disclaimer: A distinct short section immediately after the hook, headed MIỄN TRỪ TRÁCH NHIỆM, with relevant scope limits.
currentLifeExplainerPreferences.preserve: Exact approved Nhật Phong take and speech-first sound approach; keep previous revisions.
currentLifeExplainerPreferences.acceptance: Updated production capability and preferences, not user approval of a new export or model-weight training.

sourceStructureCaveat: Observed references vary: opening disclaimer in Vĩnh Hưng/TCG; Châu Âu opens with a scope caveat; Huấn has an investigation caveat later. Do not attribute the user-required four-part structure uniformly to all sources.
editingLessons: Choose the subject and relationship before choosing effects.
Use subject-related source media for specific cases and concise diagrams for causal relations.

When a clause says discount, show an actual discount marker or old/new price. Two ordinary shelf prices or different pack sizes do not establish a reduction. Keep archival offers separate from current prices and hypothetical arithmetic.
Reveal one useful relation at a time; do not turn every clause into a dashboard.
Change layouts when narrative function changes, not on an arbitrary image timer.
Return to the opening question with a supported answer before CTA.
Treat source labels, ASR, numbers and illustrations as fallible; inspect mismatches.
limits: Complete transcript and sampled-frame review is not continuous audiovisual playback or auditory approval.
Audience/retention interpretations are hypotheses; no private channel analytics were available.
Source claims were studied as rhetoric, not independently fact-verified.
Reference download does not authorize asset republication.
Saving this profile updates reusable project knowledge, not model weights.
This research does not authorize a new video or visual redesign.

contentStudy2026_11_14.coreRule: One central question and connected chapters with claim, mechanism, concrete evidence/example, one emphasis, earned bridge and hook payoff. Do not use chapter labels or effects as a substitute for a coherent argument.
contentStudy2026_11_14.newUserOverride: Complete bread-film rewrite: real footage, no cartoon cast, no subtitles, omit separate opening disclaimer, new concise exact Nhat Phong take; preserve all old batches.
